notes.title: Day 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287700/18c3a64de5449df56cdf6ee980a90f8ec5fd07de.png[/img]

Hello!
 
It's been almost 24 hours since Under the Moon was released! We are committed to continuing to improve the Under the Moon until we give you the best experience. That's why we listened to your feedback and tried to fix the issues with the day one patch.
 
[b]We've fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achivement bugs are fixed
Sound problems are fixed in maps
- Germany loop problem is fixed
- Turkish language problem is fixed
- Level Design problems are fixed (NPC stuck problem)
[/list]

[b]Thank you for believing and trusting us! Under the Moon will come to a much better game with your feedback.[/b]

notes.title: Under the Moon v1.0 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287700/e5c5508f41c49efe75d9ea2569248e5811862e6b.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that we accomplished to get v1.0 with the Under the Moon in just 6 months! Thank you for all your support and feedbacks! 

We fix all the bugs that affect your gameplay and add new levels for you to enjoy. Now you can play the rest of the story of Ali Kemal and Leyla. 

In the new chapters you will experience Germany and Scotland with new riddles to solve. Thank you again for this beatiful journey! See you on the other projects!

- The Pack Studios and Bamya Games Teams

notes.title: Under the Moon is available now!
notes.notes:
Today we’re thrilled to share that Under the Moon is now available for $3,99, with a 20% off launch week discount available until August 12.

We're excited to release our second game less than a year! Game publishing processes are as demanding as game development processes. We are very grateful to you for your support, playing the demo and providing us your feedbacks. Believe me, we're working hard to convey the best experience to you in every game we've published. Now it's time for "Under the Moon"!

We are aware of the difficulty to find riddle games on Steam, and we are happy to give you a fun and unique gaming experience! Even in just one episode demo, we have presented you with many riddles. Now, I can happily say that nearly a hundred riddles await you, together with colorful levels. We listened to your comments and added new difficulty modes to the game. We believe that, all players will be able to enjoy Under the Moon more.

Without the help of the players, our families, and our friends, this game would not have become what it is today. Thanks again everyone!

notes.title: Let's Celebrate Steam Next Fest Together!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287700/de69bb5598cd6736f1b4e34acb9c3593b2861a24.png[/img]

True Love!

We're back with a demo of our new game Under The Moon, which we've been working on for quite some time.

This will be the first open demo available during Steam Next Fest. Your feedback is extremely valuable in providing the best experience possible. You’ll also be able to watch the developer stream now.

We've all heard our parents' or grandparents' fascinating stories about how they met. Listening to a grandfather's stories around a campfire feels as authentic as it gets.

This is Ali Kemal's story to his grandchildren about meeting his wife. We will be accompanying him on this incredible journey.

Are you willing to lend a hand in pursuing his love? To figure out where the next stop is, you must solve puzzles in different countries and cultures.

Each new country will present its own set of challenges. You could even be a riddle master with multiple levels of difficulty.

Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/thepack_studios/]our socials[/url] or on[url=https://thepackstudios.com] our website[/url].

Have a safe and enjoyable journey, travelers!
